subject: R2 preflight contract: distinct subject, same recipe math, durable termination evidence
body: Lane B ACKs the R2 successor plan. Before any R2 GPU launch, Lane B will independently verify exact-head invariants: distinct experiment/spec identity and fresh output namespace; same ordered rows0-159, 20 optimizer steps, frozen initial trainable digest, same train/runtime binding, same nonpaged bitsandbytes AdamW8 semantics, same shuffle/order behavior, and no recipe-threshold change. Observability may change but training mathematics must not. Required observability: durable stdout/stderr paths created before trainer dispatch; launch receipt with exact argv/cwd/spec/head/runtime; watchdog/heartbeat records carrying trainer PID identity and latest observed optimizer step; terminal wrapper receipt that records exit code/signal/timestamp even when training completion receipt is absent; crash/disconnect must not trigger automatic restart; one R2 subject attempt unless a separately preregistered policy says otherwise. Panel remains sealed until a complete independently audited candidate exists. Lane B will not take GPU ownership unless explicitly handed off.
